name: Scenes Gathered
label: Collage Zine
description: Layered scenes, paper fragments, and quiet visual storytelling.
prompt: Create a refined collected-scenes editorial zine poster. Keep a recognizable photographic panel from the supplied photo and surround it with simplified illustrated details from the same scene, layered paper fragments and small related scene crops. Quiet handmade collage, airy asymmetric grid, cream paper, muted source-photo colors, subtle paper grain, no glossy or 3D effects. Do not invent destinations or dates.

name: Photo to Postcard
label: Illustrated Postcard
description: A photo paired with a soft illustration, arranged like a keepsake postcard.
prompt: Create a refined scrapbook postcard: photographic source scene in the top half, a simplified flat handmade illustration of that same scene in the lower half, off-white paper, muted colors from the original, generous margins and restrained editorial typography. Preserve identities and scene context in the photographic panel. No 3D, glossy rendering, or invented places and dates.

name: Travel Memory
label: Memory Sticker Card
description: Original photo, illustrated scene, and collectible die-cut paper stickers.
prompt: Create a calm nostalgic travel-memory scrapbook sticker card on cream paper. Keep the recognizable source photograph in the top half. In the lower half place a soft flat simplified handmade illustration of the same scene on the left and separate die-cut paper stickers with soft white borders on the right. If the photo features a person and a dog, use exactly two stickers: the person and the dog. Otherwise choose 5–7 iconic motifs visible in the photo. Muted source-photo colors, generous negative space, clean cute refined zine layout, matte flat illustration, not 3D, not glossy, not hyper-detailed. Do not invent places or dates.

name: Minimal Zine
label: Minimal Editorial Poster
description: Generous whitespace, a restrained palette, and a clean editorial photo layout.
prompt: Create a minimalist editorial zine poster with one dominant recognizable photographic scene, generous off-white negative space, a restrained source-photo palette, an elegant asymmetric grid and small understated flat illustrated accents. Clean artistic print layout, sparse tasteful typography, no busy collage, no 3D or glossy elements, no invented dates or destinations.
